Which of the following is the correct syntax for an if-elif-else statement in Python?

Consider the following code snippet:

```python
x = 15
y = 20
if x > 10 and y > 25:
    print("Both conditions are true")
elif x > 10 and y > 15:
    print("First condition true, second false")
else:
    print("At least one condition is false")
```
What will be printed?

options.C: At least one condition is false
